svg.title: Guide-word scenes: F-08 Safety envelope and camera-message forwarding under its SC guide words (WP-C-03 §4), phone view
svg.desc: 4 cards for F-08 Safety envelope and camera-message forwarding, one per SC guide word. M03 Unrequested Function: H-08, SG-07 ASIL B; callout: runs into the stopped car. M04 Function Stuck: H-02, SG-02 ASIL C; callout: crosses edge line. M05 Excessive Function: H-02, SG-02 ASIL C, covered by M04; callout: drifts wide in the curve. M13 Erratic or Intermittent: H-02, SG-02 ASIL C, covered by M04; callout: blocks on and off.
svg.text: Guide-word scenes · F-08 Safety envelope and camera-message
The 4 safety-relevant (SC) guide words. Chart: the function (commands or messages passed), required
vs performed. Scene: what it does to the car.
WP-C-03 §4 · hara_model.FM · schematic, not simulation output · phone view
Suppression of the vehicle's stock pre-collision
Relay or forwarding blocks, delays or alters camera
PCS/AEB messages, or the item transmits on PCS
Unannounced loss or degradation of lateral control
Envelope stuck in a blocking state (e.g.
controls_allowed stuck false, relay stuck) while the
SoC shows engaged: lateral and longitudinal
Unannounced loss or degradation of lateral control
Over-limiting: valid commands rejected; same as
Unannounced loss or degradation of lateral control
Intermittent blocking: each block behaves as stuck
Scenes are drawn to explain each hazard; the plant runs are in assurance/sim §3.7. Ratings are proposals for review
until the I3 confirmation review (WP-C-03 header). Generated by hara_figures.py.
